sentences.text: Shantel VanSanten -LRB- born July 25 , 1985 -RRB- is an American model and actress .	American	Americans
As a model , she has been featured in the magazines Teen Vogue and Seventeen .	Teen Vogue	Teen Vogue	Seventeen	Seventeen (magazine)

On television , she played the role of Quinn James in the CW teen drama series One Tree Hill , recurred as Detective Patty Spivot in the CW show The Flash , and stars as Julie Swagger the wife of lead character Bob Lee Swagger on the USA Network series Shooter .
